opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: The scheme is covered under the Full Economic Costing (FEC) regime. Currently, the Academy funds 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, based at an eligible university or research organisation in the UK, and have completed their Viva Voce examination between 1st April 2024 to 1st April 2027.
opportunities.summary: The British Academy Postdoctoral Fellowships is a three-year award for outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to pursue an independent research project and integrate into the academic community.
